description: Single source of truth for contract governance. Read by the governance crate (code/rust/src/governance), by every workspace build.rs, by governance-check, and by scripts/score_scope_contracts.py and scripts/contract_scores.py.

floor.statement: A governed source is accepted only with a completed score (every gate graded, score_token = level + composite grade) at capability level L4 or L5 and composite grade D or better. Sources in governance/baseline.json with unchanged bytes are grandfathered.

companion.naming: <dir>/<stem>.contract.score.yaml; when a sibling with the same stem and another collision suffix exists, <dir>/<name>.contract.score.yaml.

discovery: git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard -z, filtered by the population globs and exclusions; build scripts walk their own package instead.

pinned_boilerplate.reason: The build hook (two comment lines and a main) that calls governance::verify_crate_contracts!(). It carries no logic of its own; the logic it calls is scored with the governance crate. Only byte-identical copies are exempt; any other build.rs needs its own companion.

modes.warn: default; each violation is a cargo warning and the build continues
modes.new: abort the build when a file outside the baseline fails; warn for the rest
modes.enforce: abort the build on any violation (CI)
